title: 'I love the eyes on me.' Giants' Cam Skattebo back after brutal injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'I love the eyes on me.' Giants' Cam Skattebo back after brutal injury
sources.description: Giants RB Cam Skattebo explored what life looked like outside of football as he rehabbed his dislocated ankle. Now he's ready to return to the field.
